text.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

words.gloss_range: rhetorical negative question particle pressing acknowledgment rather than seeking new information
words.prose: {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:ʾa-lam}}) opens as a negative question whose force is affirmative pressure. The particle governs the following jussive verb while making the listener acknowledge what the ayah will then confirm in two declarative clauses.

topics.headline: negative question as compelled affirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin by making denial untenable rather than by requesting information.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the fused interrogative and negative particle, and the local clause shows it governing the knowledge question.

topics.headline: particle controls following jussive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word already shapes the grammar of the next word.
topics.reason: The lam component governs the following second-person imperfect as jussive.

topics.headline: question opening leads to declarative closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah's movement from compelled assent into doubled confirmation.
topics.reason: The opening question is followed by two separate emphatic nominal clauses.

words.gloss_range: addressed human knowing as compelled recognition, not new instruction or an attribute
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, recognition, learning, teaching, informing, and sign-marking; here the local Form I verb selects recognition/knowing while the wider field colors it as legibility
words.prose: {{ar:تَعْلَمْ}} ({{tr:taʿlam}}) makes the addressee grammatically present and pressed into recognition. Its jussive form contrasts with {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}): human knowing is compelled acknowledgment, while divine knowing is stable and wide. The root field can include teaching, informing, learning, and signs, but the local Form I verb selects recognition rather than a causative act of instruction. The recurring have-you-not-known pattern (2:106; 5:40; 9:104; 57:17) turns the prior dispute into a personal concession of foundational divine knowledge.

topics.headline: addressed jussive recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the singular listener being grammatically pressed to acknowledge the claim.
topics.reason: The verb is second-person masculine singular and jussive under the preceding particle.

topics.headline: same root separates human and divine knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same knowledge root form a hierarchy: human acknowledgment faces divine omniscience.
topics.reason: The two Form I imperfects differ in person, mood, and object scope.

topics.headline: knowledge root carries legibility and transfer pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels knowing as recognition within a larger field of legible signs and transmitted knowledge, while the local form remains basic knowing.
topics.reason: The broader root family is relevant as pressure, but local grammar selects Form I recognition, not teaching or informing.

topics.headline: formula turns dispute into personal concession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior dispute is answered by a personal demand to concede foundational divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The recurrent opening formula and the boundary rows both describe the shift from dispute to addressed acknowledgment.

words.gloss_range: factual complement marker making the divine-knowledge clause the object of human knowing
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾanna}}) is the hinge that turns the divine-knowledge statement into the content of the addressee's knowing. Its geminated fact-marking keeps the claim factual, not hypothetical or purposive, and prepares the later emphatic particles.

topics.headline: fact clause becomes object of knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one clause hold together human acknowledgment and divine omniscience.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the content complement governed by the addressed knowledge verb and governs the divine name as its subject.

topics.headline: factual marker blocks hypothetical reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the embedded proposition as established fact, not as possibility or purpose.
topics.reason: The local particle is the geminated factual complement marker, not the ungeminated purposive or subjunctive particle.

topics.headline: assertive particle family prepares confirmations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement through fact-marking into repeated emphatic confirmation.
topics.reason: The particle belongs to the same assertive/geminated family visible in the later emphatic clauses.

words.gloss_range: the unique divine proper name as accusative subject of the embedded knowing clause
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field tied to worship, deity, and contested reverent-bewilderment analyses; here it names the unique subject of total knowledge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same divine name in the final ease frame

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) names the unique divine referent as the subject of the embedded knowing clause. The accusative case comes from the governing factual particle, so God is not merely mentioned but grammatically installed as the knower. Root-dispute pressure around worship and reverent bewilderment survives as a way the proper name intensifies the named knower, while the proper-name form blocks any generic deity reading. The same named referent later appears as {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}), so the ayah frames its core by moving from the named knower to the one for whom the whole matter is easy.

topics.headline: proper name as embedded subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine omniscience anchored in the unique proper name, not an abstract or generic deity.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes the proper name the accusative subject of the factual clause and the explicit subject of the knowing verb.

topics.headline: worship and bewilderment pressure around the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the named knower as the one before whom knowledge and worship converge, while the local sense remains the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute does not replace the proper name locally, but it provides valid reverential pressure.

topics.headline: first divine name anticipates final divine frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one divine referent appearing first as knower and later as the one for whom the whole matter is easy.
topics.reason: The same proper name recurs with different case and role at the close.

topics.headline: local divine-name and knowledge pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause enact a wider knowledge-divinity pairing in the immediate phrase.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and same-surah rows are realized locally by the divine name beside the knowing verb and by contrast with earlier no-book ignorance in 22:8.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine knowing with unrestricted contents as object
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, recognition, learning, teaching, informing, and sign-marking; here Form I selects direct divine knowing over causative teaching or informing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: addressed human knowing under interrogative pressure

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) answers the pressured human verb with stable divine knowing. It takes {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as an unrestricted object, so the verb covers whatever is inside the upper and lower domains. The root's sign and transfer field makes divine knowing feel like perfect reading of every marked state, but the local Form I verb presents direct divine cognition, not teaching someone else. This present omniscience grounds the prior judgment over dispute instead of leaving it as bare authority.

topics.headline: stable indicative divine knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears divine knowing as ongoing and factual, unlike the pressured human acknowledgment.
topics.reason: The verb is third-person indicative inside the factual clause with God as subject.

topics.headline: whatever in heaven and earth as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is not a named item but whatever fills the cosmic domains.
topics.reason: The verb governs the relative pronoun whose domain is specified by the following prepositional phrase and coordination.

topics.headline: knowledge root as legibility, not causation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels divine knowing as perfect reading of every marked state, while local morphology keeps it direct knowing rather than teaching or informing.
topics.reason: The wider root family supplies pressure, but the local Form I verb does not activate causative or pedagogic stems.

topics.headline: judgment grounded in present omniscience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior judgment claim rest on already active divine knowledge of the whole domain.
topics.reason: The boundary and collocation rows are locally realized by the verb governing the heaven-earth field.

topics.headline: knowledge echo ranks agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repeated root create hierarchy rather than equivalence between human and divine knowing.
topics.reason: The same root recurs with changed person, mood, subject, and scope.

words.gloss_range: open relative object meaning whatever falls inside the following cosmic domain
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the known object open: whatever is in the sky and earth, without listing its contents. It becomes the grammatical nucleus that the following containment phrase specifies, so the prior disputed matter is swallowed into a much wider divine-knowledge scope.

topics.headline: unrestricted whatever as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exhaustive scope without an inventory of known things.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the direct object of the divine knowing verb.

topics.headline: contents specified by containment phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heaven-earth phrase functioning as the domain of contents known, not as a detached location.
topics.reason: The following prepositional phrase modifies the relative object and supplies its domain.

topics.headline: prior dispute enclosed by whatever
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the disputed what from the prior ayah placed inside the wider whatever of divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the open relative scope and is not contradicted by local syntax.

words.gloss_range: spatial containment marking the domain inside which the known contents fall
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) first marks spatial containment: the known contents are inside the upper and lower domains. Because a later {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) places the same matter in a record, the ayah links cosmic enclosure to inscriptive enclosure without making the first preposition merely locative decoration.

topics.headline: single preposition governs cosmic domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the object of knowledge as contents within a domain, not only heaven and earth as labels.
topics.reason: The first preposition governs the sky and, through coordination, the earth inside the relative object phrase.

topics.headline: spatial containment prepares record containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same preposition carry the ayah from what is in the cosmos to what is in a record.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition occurs in two licensed local phrases with different containment domains.

topics.headline: inside-ness becomes an argument pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels record inscription as a second enclosure built on the concrete first enclosure.
topics.reason: The concrete containment image is supported by the local repetition of the preposition.

words.gloss_range: definite singular upper domain in the heaven-earth totality, not a plural-layer inventory
words.root_gloss_range: elevation, height, sky, ceiling, and what descends from above; here the local pair selects the upper cosmic domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) is genitive under the preposition and supplies the definite singular upper domain. Its elevation root pressure makes the pair with {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}) spatially vivid, while the singular form compresses the upper realm into one pole rather than opening a layered inventory. Wider sky, rain, and ceiling senses remain background pressure; the local pair selects cosmic upperness. After earlier same-surah sky scenes (22:15; 22:18; 22:28; 22:31; 22:33), this upper domain is drawn into the later record claim.

topics.headline: genitive definite upper container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sky as the governed upper container of the whatever-scope.
topics.reason: The noun is definite singular and genitive after the preposition.

topics.headline: elevation root selects upperness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sky term as upper register, while rain, ceiling, and naming alternatives do not control this local sense.
topics.reason: The local heaven-earth pairing selects elevation and upper domain; broader polysemy remains only image pressure.

topics.headline: singular sky forms a two-pole cosmos
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the singular sky balancing singular earth as a compressed totality rather than a list of layers.
topics.reason: The surface uses singular definite nouns for both poles.

topics.headline: sky field moves toward record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the known upper domain drawn into the later record claim within the same surah's sky field.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and same-surah rows are locally anchored by the sky-earth pair and the following record clause.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle that binds earth to sky within one governed prepositional domain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than add a noun. It keeps earth coordinated with sky under the same preposition, so elevated and grounded domains become one inclusive field for divine knowledge.

topics.headline: earth inherits the same prepositional frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one compound domain rather than two separate knowledge claims.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows earth coordinated with sky and sharing the prepositional governance.

topics.headline: upper and lower become one totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels contrast and inclusion working together: sky and earth remain distinct while forming one scope.
topics.reason: The conjunction binds the two poles into one meristic span.

words.gloss_range: definite lower terrestrial domain completing the heaven-earth totality
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, and grounded expanse; here it supplies the lower pole of the known cosmic domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}) completes the lower pole of the known domain. It is genitive inside the same prepositional phrase as {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}), so the terrestrial field is not an add-on but part of one total scope. Its grounded noun stability sharpens the contrast with the elevated sky before both domains are pulled toward the record. The recurring earth field in the surah (22:18; 22:41; 22:46; 22:63; 22:64) reappears here as a known domain rather than a creation, ritual, or ownership scene.

topics.headline: earth shares the containment frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earth as the definite lower domain governed with the sky in one phrase.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated with sky and remains under the same prepositional governance.

topics.headline: grounded lower plane against sky
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the totality as vertical and concrete, not merely abstract scope.
topics.reason: The root and form evidence support earth as the stable lower terrestrial pole.

topics.headline: sky-earth pair asserts total domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the pair as a totalizing merism for the scope of divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The strong sky-earth pair is directly instantiated in the local phrase.

topics.headline: terrestrial domain is drawn into inscription
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recurring earth field gathered under knowledge and then moved toward the record claim.
topics.reason: The earth term is locally governed by the knowing scope and followed by the record clause.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the first nominal confirmation after the question
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) changes the mode from pressured question to emphatic confirmation. It governs the demonstrative subject and sets up the first of two matched clauses: first the matter is in a record, then it is easy for God.

topics.headline: first nominal assurance after the question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah move from demanded acknowledgment into direct confirmation.
topics.reason: The particle opens a separate emphatic nominal clause after the initial question.

topics.headline: demonstrative subject with record predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior proposition turned into the subject of an inscription claim.
topics.reason: Local syntax identifies the demonstrative as the particle's subject and the prepositional phrase as predicate.

topics.headline: paired emphatic closures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks record and ease as coordinated confirmations, not loose appendices.
topics.reason: The same emphatic opening recurs before the final ease clause.

words.gloss_range: far demonstrative packaging the prior divine-knowledge proposition as one referent
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) compresses the whole prior divine-knowledge claim into a single subject for the record predicate. Its far deixis gives the proposition conceptual weight: not one nearby noun, but the whole knowing of whatever is in the sky and earth is now located in {{ar:كِتَٰبٍ}} ({{tr:kitābin}}).

topics.headline: whole prior clause becomes one subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a full omniscience proposition being compressed into one grammatical pointer.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is the subject of the emphatic clause and points back to the prior proposition.

topics.headline: referent is the whole claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids reducing the pointer to a single adjacent word; it carries the complete first beat into inscription.
topics.reason: Referent evidence and local syntax support a clausal proposition as the demonstrative's referent.

topics.headline: far pointer starts the demonstrative chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the proposition lifted for evaluation and then reused in the final ease clause.
topics.reason: Both demonstratives point anaphorically, with changing predicates across the paired clauses.

words.gloss_range: inscriptive containment locating the proposition in a record

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: spatial containment in heaven and earth

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) now marks inscriptive containment. The same inside-logic that first held contents within sky and earth now places the whole proposition inside a record, so the ayah moves from cosmic domain to written register.

topics.headline: record as container of the proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the record as the grammatical container in which the prior proposition is located.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the record noun as the predicate of the emphatic demonstrative clause.

topics.headline: inside-ness shifts from cosmos to record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one preposition carrying the argument from existence in the cosmos to storage in a register.
topics.reason: The same preposition appears in two local containment frames with different domains.

topics.headline: dispute and cosmos resolve into inscription
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the enclosure logic of the surrounding discourse culminate in recorded fixity.
topics.reason: The boundary rows cohere with the repeated local containment construction and the following record noun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite written record as a vast fixed register, not a named titled book
words.root_gloss_range: writing, recording, prescribing, decreeing, and joining into a fixed register; here the noun selects record/register while decree and joining pressure remain relevant
words.prose: {{ar:كِتَٰبٍ}} ({{tr:kitābin}}) is an indefinite record: unnamed, but conceptually vast. As the object of the inscriptive preposition, it holds the proposition rather than acting as the clause subject. The root family adds writing, prescription, decree, and joining pressure, so the record feels like a fixed gathered register; local grammar, however, selects a standing record rather than the event of decreeing. Structurally it is the middle beat between acknowledged knowledge and final ease. Against human divergence and the no-knowledge/no-book contrast (22:8), the record supplies present inscribed fixity rather than deferred discovery.

topics.headline: unnamed record magnifies the register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the record is not named as a titled book; indefiniteness leaves it vast and weighty.
topics.reason: The noun is singular indefinite and locally functions as the record container.

topics.headline: record is governed container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the book as the location of the proposition, not the grammatical subject doing an action.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition in the predicate phrase.

topics.headline: written decree and joining field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the record as fixed and gathered, while local grammar keeps record/register as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports writing, prescription, and joining pressure, but the local noun is a standing record rather than a passive decree event or contract.

topics.headline: noun rather than passive decree event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recordhood as a settled repository instead of an enacted prescribing verb.
topics.reason: The surface is the noun, not the passive verbal form supplied elsewhere in the root family.

topics.headline: knowing and recording converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge move into inscription before the ayah closes with ease.
topics.reason: The record clause follows the divine knowing clause and precedes the ease clause in a three-beat structure.

topics.headline: dispute answered by inscribed fixity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees human divergence answered by a present fixed register rather than deferred discovery.
topics.reason: The boundary and same-surah rows cohere with the local record claim and do not override its grammar.

topics.headline: record framed by divine name and ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record placed between the named knower and the final divine ease frame.
topics.reason: The book noun stands between the two divine-name occurrences and before the final ease predicate.

words.gloss_range: renewed emphatic particle opening the final ease assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) restarts the grammar for the final assurance instead of merely extending the book clause. The repeated emphatic frame makes the close a paired refrain: record first, then ease upon God.

topics.headline: second emphatic clause restarts governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ease statement as a fresh assertion, not a subordinate afterthought.
topics.reason: The second particle opens a separate emphatic nominal clause and governs the following demonstrative.

topics.headline: emphasis moves from record to ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees certainty shift from inscription to divine capacity.
topics.reason: The repeated particle keeps emphatic force while the predicate field changes from record containment to ease.

topics.headline: paired declarative closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second half of the ayah as a structured record-plus-ease refrain.
topics.reason: The sequence repeats the emphatic particle plus demonstrative frame with a changed predicate.

words.gloss_range: far demonstrative whose referent has accumulated knowledge plus inscription

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first demonstrative referring to divine knowledge

words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) is heavier the second time. It does not reset to the nearest phrase; it gathers the divine knowledge claim plus its inscription and makes that accumulated matter the subject of final ease. The far demonstrative lets the proposition feel weighty before the final ease predicate dissolves any burden.

topics.headline: second demonstrative gathers knowledge plus record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second pointer carries more content than the first: knowing plus inscription.
topics.reason: The second demonstrative is the subject of the final emphatic clause and refers back through the prior clauses.

topics.headline: compound subject waits for ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ease predicated of the whole knowledge-record configuration, not only of the nearest clause.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is separated from the final predicate by the divine prepositional phrase, and the predicate resolves the accumulated subject.

topics.headline: far deixis creates weight before ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the combined matter as rhetorically weighty just before the final adjective declares it easy.
topics.reason: The repeated far demonstrative and delayed predicate create the local rhetorical effect.

topics.headline: enclosed matter carried into closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees disputed matter become known, recorded, and finally easy for God as one compound closure.
topics.reason: The boundary and synthetic rows are supported by the local twin demonstrative frame and final ease predicate.

words.gloss_range: preposition setting God as the frame upon whom the matter is easy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: God plus the final ease predicate

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) sets the divine frame before the reader reaches the final adjective. The phrase headed by it depends on the ease predicate but precedes it, so the ayah first names who the matter is easy for. Its usual burden or superposition pressure is inverted by the final ease: what might read as weight upon another is effortless in relation to God.

topics.headline: preposition marks the frame for ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands ease as assessed specifically with respect to God.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name as complement of the final adjective.

topics.headline: who comes before the quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reaches the divine frame before hearing the final quality of ease.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the predicate adjective while depending on it.

topics.headline: burden or superposition image becomes effortless capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the potential weight of what is upon someone turned into no weight for God.
topics.reason: The preposition can carry superposition or burden pressure, but the local adjective of ease controls the construction and turns that pressure into capacity.

words.gloss_range: the same unique divine proper name in genitive as the capacity frame for ease
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field tied to worship, deity, and contested reverent-bewilderment analyses; here it names the one for whom the whole matter is easy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same divine name as subject of knowing

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is the same proper name as the earlier {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}), but now governed by the preceding preposition. The case shift preserves one referent while changing the role: first God is the named knower, now God is the one for whom the knowledge-record matter is easy. Root-dispute pressure remains reverential background, not a replacement for the proper name.

topics.headline: named God as the frame for ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ease attached directly to the named God, not to an abstract capacity principle.
topics.reason: The definite proper name is governed by the preposition as complement of the ease predicate.

topics.headline: same name, changed grammatical role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one divine referent moving from subject of knowing to frame of ease.
topics.reason: The two occurrences differ in case because their governors differ, while lexical identity remains stable.

topics.headline: reverential name pressure in final frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the worship and bewilderment field now placed inside the final capacity frame, while the local word remains the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The root dispute supplies pressure but does not change the local proper-name reading.

topics.headline: divine name ties record to ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same named God frame knowledge, record, and final ease.
topics.reason: The final divine-name occurrence stands between the record claim and the ease predicate.

topics.headline: divine-name echo closes the frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's central proposition bookended by the divine name.
topics.reason: The repeated proper name forms an internal frame from the embedded knowledge clause to the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: indefinite qualitative adjective predicating ease, facility, and lack of resistance for God
words.root_gloss_range: ease, facility, smoothness, unblocked movement, and contrast with difficulty; here the adjective selects effortless divine capacity, while wider easy-gain or left-side associations remain only image pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يَسِيرٌ}} ({{tr:yasīrun}}) is the delayed final predicate that resolves the accumulated demonstrative. Its qualitative adjective form says the whole knowledge-and-record matter is easy upon God, not that God is newly making it easy. The root's smoothness and ease field makes the close feel frictionless and unobstructed, while wider left-side or easy-gain associations remain image pressure. As an easy-for-God formula, the close aligns this omniscience and record argument with divine-power closures (35:11; 57:22; 64:7). After {{ar:كِتَٰبٍ}} ({{tr:kitābin}}) supplies fixed inscription, this final word supplies effortless flow.

topics.headline: final adjective resolves the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah hold back its final quality until the last word.
topics.reason: The adjective is the predicate of the second emphatic clause and comes after the intervening divine prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: ease as qualitative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ease presented as the matter's quality in relation to God, not as a narrated act of making easy.
topics.reason: The surface is an indefinite qualitative adjective, not a causative verb.

topics.headline: smooth unobstructed ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels comprehensive knowledge and inscription as meeting no resistance for God.
topics.reason: The root field supports ease, facility, and smoothness; broader left-side or easy-gain senses remain only image pressure.

topics.headline: ease contrasts difficulty for creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final adjective implicitly overturn the difficulty such a total proposition would pose for others.
topics.reason: The supplied antonym relation coheres with the final divine-capacity formula.

topics.headline: recurring easy-for-God closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the close as a divine-capacity formula applied here to omniscience and record.
topics.reason: The row supplies concrete formula references and the local phrase realizes the formula.

topics.headline: fixed record meets effortless ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah finish by joining settled inscription with unresisted divine facility.
topics.reason: The record predicate and the ease predicate are linked by sequence, root co-occurrence, and nunated clause endings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled knowing at words 2 and 5, the heaven-earth merism at words 8 and 9, the book at word 13, and ease at word 18.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rhetorical question makes the addressee's knowing answer to divine disclosure; the upper and lower domains exhaust the field, inscription stabilizes that field, and ease denies any burden in encompassing it.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies the repeated epistemic hinge between human recognition and divine knowledge.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper half of the ayah's exhaustive vertical domain.
The lower realm opposite heaven closes the merism so that no spatial remainder is left outside knowledge.
Ordered letters and their written product give exhaustive knowing a stable inscribed form.
Opening into ease after difficulty negates strain in maintaining the total field and its inscription.

changed_reading.before: A bare assertion that God is omniscient.
changed_reading.after: A summons to recognize exhaustive knowledge whose whole vertical domain is disclosed, stably inscribed, and held without burden.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun kitab at word 13 and the concluding yasir at word 18.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book can be read as an operation as well as a container: scattered particulars are joined into one register and thereby fixed as an effective determination, while ease describes their unresisting availability to that order.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another turns the book into the gathering operation that binds dispersed particulars.
An established writing that obligates judgment or destiny makes the gathered register effective rather than merely descriptive.
Lightness and ready compliance in motion supply the register's frictionless availability to divine determination.

changed_reading.before: The book is a passive container of already known facts.
changed_reading.after: The book is a joined and binding register in which dispersed facts become one readily governed order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated root of knowing, the split inventory attached to al-sama at word 8, and kitab at word 13.
baseline_models.mechanism: A secondary branch network recasts knowledge as differentiation by marks: the world is not only contained by awareness but bears traces by which each thing is distinguished, and the book serializes those traces as writing.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing trace that guides toward its object turns knowing into recognition through marks.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible brand supplies a deliberately form-distant model of a marked cosmos.
Writing orders the distinguishing marks into a legible record.

changed_reading.before: Knowing means inward possession of information.
changed_reading.after: Knowing may also mean perfect legibility: every thing is differentiated by a trace that can be read in the book.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early pairing of dispute with absent knowledge, guidance, and an illuminating book, followed after the focus by worship without compelling authority or knowledge, revises the focus book from a sealed archive into the positive evidentiary warrant that unsupported claims lack.

activation_trace.role: Twisted contention supplies the argumentative problem that a warranted book must answer.
Disclosure to a knower is explicitly missing from the dispute, defining the epistemic deficit.
Gentle indication toward the true path makes evidence directional rather than merely stored.
The written product is the missing textual warrant coordinated with knowledge and guidance.
Illumination makes the book's evidentiary contribution one of disclosure and visibility.
The later absence of disclosed knowledge repeats the criterion against unauthorized worship.
Compelling proof gives the missing authority a forensic evidentiary force.
The focus inscription becomes the positive textual pole against both stated deficits.

structural_cues: 22:3 first couples dispute with lack of knowledge; 22:8 repeats the charge and adds lack of guidance and an illuminating book.
22:71 immediately follows the focus with a parallel lack of compelling authority and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated knowledge deficits and the explicit triad of knowledge, guidance, and illuminating book; I infer that 22:70's book can function as their positive warrant. A live alternative is that the focus book remains a hidden divine ledger while 22:8 names a publicly available scripture.

changed_reading.before: The book is an inaccessible inventory known only to God.
changed_reading.after: The book also names the luminous warrant behind defensible judgment, opposed to twisted dispute and unsupported worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The life-cycle sequence lets human knowing be acquired and then lost, while the earth and the human creature pass through dead and living states. Against that reversibility, the focus book reads as an external continuity that retains every phase even when the embodied knower cannot.

activation_trace.role: Return to an earlier condition supplies the reversal that strips the human subject of a later capacity.
Disclosure followed by not knowing after knowledge exposes the fragility of embodied cognition.
Soft productive earth supplies a material state that reappears after the preceding lifelessness.
Animate life supplies the state bestowed, removed, and restored around death.
Loss of force and life marks the interruption across which continuity must be preserved.
Stable inscription supplies memory outside the changing creature and landscape.

structural_cues: 22:5 places childhood, maturity, death or senescent regression, lost knowledge, and revived earth in one ordered sequence.
22:66 compresses the human trajectory into life, death, and renewed life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversible cognition and life; I infer that inscription preserves the trajectory across states the subject cannot continuously remember. The book may instead record only predetermined endpoints rather than functioning as counter-memory.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge is a timeless snapshot of everything.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge is also continuity across changing states, with the book retaining what embodied memory and life lose.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separation of rival groups, knowledgeable witness, known deeds, and judgment over disagreement form a forensic chain. In that chain the focus book is the complete dossier that connects exhaustive knowledge to a differentiating verdict, and ease describes adjudication without evidentiary uncertainty.

activation_trace.role: A judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the differentiating endpoint of the dossier.
Testimony stated from knowledge supplies the evidentiary competence behind universal judgment.
Superior disclosure of the opponents' deeds bridges their dispute to the focus assertion of knowledge.
Intentional deeds provide the case material known and entered into judgment.
Judgment between people supplies the immediate legal function for the focus knowledge and book.
Parties taking divergent paths supplies the disagreement the judgment must resolve.
Binding inscription turns complete evidence into a verdict-bearing register.
Ease after difficulty removes the uncertainty and labor that constrain human adjudication.

structural_cues: 22:17 announces both separation among communities and witness over every thing.
22:68-70 forms an immediate sequence of dispute, superior knowledge of deeds, future judgment over disagreement, exhaustive knowledge, and book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, deeds, disagreement, and judgment around the focus; I infer that the book functions as the dossier connecting evidence to verdict. It could instead be the decree produced by judgment or a cosmological record with no courtroom function.

changed_reading.before: The book inventories cosmic facts without a specified use.
changed_reading.after: The book is a complete adjudicative dossier through which disputed deeds can be separated without evidentiary difficulty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of recitation or wish, adversarial casting, removal with replacement, and firming of signs supplies a textual integrity process. The focus book therefore need not be imagined as inertly untouched; it can be a record whose stability is actively preserved through detection, correction, and confirmation by knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Recitation read and placed in its positions supplies the textual channel into which the interruption enters.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive insertion that tests textual integrity.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the corrective operation rather than simple deletion.
Firmness, precision, and secure construction supply the stabilized result of correction.
A visible sign supplies the unit whose integrity is restored and made recognizable.
Disclosure to those given knowledge supplies recognition that the stabilized signs are true.
The written product receives the sequence's model of actively maintained textual stability.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders the operations as casting, removal, and then firming of signs.
22:53-54 turns the disturbance into a test and the stabilized result into truth recognized by those given knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a correction-and-firming sequence; I infer that it can characterize how a book remains trustworthy under interference. A live alternative is that the sequence concerns recited signs only and should not be transferred to the cosmological book of 22:70.

changed_reading.before: A trustworthy book must be pictured as a static artifact never exposed to disturbance.
changed_reading.after: The book may be trustworthy because its inscription is actively corrected, secured, and recognized through knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rain descends, earth greens, ships move under command, and the sky is held from falling. These transitions convert the focus heaven-earth merism from a static inventory into a regulated system, so the book can be read as the effective ordering and constraint register by which those motions remain tractable.

activation_trace.role: Descent and arrival supply the first directed transition between heaven and earth.
The overhanging sky supplies the upper source domain from which water moves.
Soft productive earth supplies the receiving substrate transformed by descent.
Fresh green growth makes the regulated transition materially visible.
Fineness and hidden scale supply the micro-level subtlety within the visible ecological change.
Knowledge of reports and inward reality joins visible greening to its hidden process.
Subduing and directing something toward a purpose supplies governed motion within the system.
Holding and restraining supplies the negative constraint that keeps the sky-earth relation stable.
Falling and becoming fixed names the event actively prevented by that constraint.
Effective determination lets the book function as an ordering register for the observed transitions and constraints.
Lightness and compliance in motion characterize the regulated system's tractability.

structural_cues: 22:63 moves water from sky to greening earth and closes with subtle, inwardly informed knowledge.
22:64 restates possession of heaven and earth; 22:65 adds directed earthly and maritime motion plus the restrained fall of sky onto earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies motions, transformations, and constraints across the same heaven-earth pair; I infer that the focus book can be an operational ordering of those relations. It may remain only a descriptive record, with governance supplied independently by the surrounding ayat.

changed_reading.before: Heaven and earth are static regions whose contents are listed in a book.
changed_reading.after: Heaven and earth are a dynamically regulated system whose transformations and constraints are comprehensively ordered and effortless to govern.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promise that does not fail despite radically different measures of a day, followed by knowledge of what lies before and behind and the return of all matters, extends the focus register across delay and temporal direction. Ease then means that long duration is no obstacle, not that execution must look immediate to humans.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of a promise missing its time is explicitly negated, establishing non-failure across delay.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the obligation that persists across differing clocks.
The year supplies the long human measure contrasted with the single divine day.
Enumeration supplies the human act of measuring the temporal disparity.
Disclosure to the knower extends the focus formula into a directional temporal horizon.
What lies between the hands supplies the forward-facing side of that horizon.
What lies behind supplies the complementary rearward side of the horizon.
Return to an origin gives all registered trajectories a common endpoint.
Matters and states supply the entities whose trajectories return.
Ease after difficulty removes long duration as an obstacle to knowledge or fulfillment.

structural_cues: 22:47 contrasts a divine day with a thousand counted years while denying failure of the promise.
22:76 restates divine knowing after the focus as what is before them and behind them, then makes all matters return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent temporal measures, non-failing promise, directional knowledge, and return; I infer that the focus book holds whole trajectories rather than present states alone. The before-behind expression may be spatial or epistemic rather than strictly temporal, so the temporal extension remains non-exclusive.

changed_reading.before: Ease suggests immediate execution on a human timescale.
changed_reading.after: Ease means that no duration or temporal direction strains a register containing complete trajectories and their eventual return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant W-S-M mapping attached to the focus root S-M-W and should not be presented as the etymology of sama. It remains anchored in the focus sky-earth-book sequence and in 22:63's rain-to-greenness transition. Downstream prose should label it a material lexical activation: rain makes the earth resemble a page marked into legibility.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-sama at word 8, al-ard at word 9, and kitab at word 13, activated by the same sky-earth transition in 22:63.

activation_trace.role: First rain that marks earth with vegetation turns the sky term into the source of a visible terrestrial inscription.
Soft productive earth supplies the page-like receptive material on which the mark appears.
Written letters supply the explicit inscription analogue for the rain-produced marks.
Descent makes the sky's marking action move onto the receiving earth.
The mapped rain-mark image is materially enacted by water descending from the named sky.
Productive earth is the substrate whose latent content becomes visible.
Fresh green growth is the visible script produced on that substrate.

changed_reading.before: The book is remote from the material world it records.
changed_reading.after: The sky writes the earth through rain and greenness, making the material world itself an exploratory analogue of the book's legible record.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 22:70 never explicitly calls its book a communal roster, and the later naming and witnessing are not syntactically linked to it. It remains anchored in the book branch of entering a name into a register and the knowledge branch of distinguishing marks, then activated by recognition, selection, naming, and witness roles. Downstream prose should present it as an institutional analogy, not as an exclusive identification of the book.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The distinguishing-mark branch of knowing at words 2 and 5 and the registry branch of kitab at word 13.

activation_trace.role: A trace that distinguishes and guides toward its bearer supplies the roster's legibility.
Entering a name into a register or group supplies the institutional roster model.
Recognition and discrimination from a sign show identity and disposition becoming externally legible.
Selecting a chosen subset supplies the enrollment boundary of the roster.
Naming as designation supplies the explicit assignment of a registered communal identity.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the duty attached to the named identity.

changed_reading.before: The book records impersonal cosmic contents.
changed_reading.after: The book can faintly resemble a roster in which selected and named persons are legible as bearers of witness obligations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the lots-and-camel-division branch is distant from the ordinary adjective yasir, and no lots occur explicitly in 22:70. It remains anchored in the focus Y-S-R inventory and gains a concrete analogue from the sacrificial animal and commanded feeding in 22:36. Downstream prose must treat this only as a speculative material analogy for orderly apportionment, never translate yasir as lottery or sacrifice.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yasir at word 18 alongside the binding-decree branch of kitab at word 13.

activation_trace.role: Lots, gaming arrows, and division of a slaughtered camel supply the distant image of ordered apportionment.
Binding determination turns apportionment from chance into an ordered allocation within the register.
The dedicated sacrificial animal supplies the same material domain as the focus branch's divided camel.
Falling marks the completion after which the animal becomes available for distribution.
Feeding others supplies the actual directed distribution of the divided provision.

changed_reading.before: Easy only denies difficulty in divine knowing.
changed_reading.after: At the furthest exploratory edge, ease also evokes the orderly apportionability of everything held under a binding register.

strongest_changes: The immediate dispute-judgment sequence turns the book into an adjudicative dossier joining known deeds to a differentiating verdict.
The sky-earth transitions of 22:63-65 turn a static cosmic inventory into a regulated system of motion, transformation, and restraint.
Human forgetting and life-death reversals make the book an external continuity across states rather than a timeless snapshot.
The correction-and-firming sequence of 22:52-54 permits a model of actively preserved textual integrity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained legal, epistemic, temporal, ecological, and textual mechanisms at once. Its split S-M-W inventory also activated an unusually concrete rain-writing model, while K-T-B supported both inscription and effective decree without forcing those readings to collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the focus book is accessible evidentiary scripture, a hidden cosmic record, an effective decree, or several of these at once remains unresolved.
The operational-system reading depends on a reader-supplied arrow from recorded order to governing specification.
The rain-writing, witness-roster, and apportionment models are branch-distant analogies and must remain explicitly exploratory.
The before-behind horizon in 22:76 may be temporal, spatial, epistemic, or deliberately polyvalent.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Comprehensive knowledge is joined into a stable record.** Repeated `ع ل م B001` gives clear knowing; `س م و B004` and `ء ر ض B001` span upper and lower domains; `ك ت ب B001/B002/B003` joins, writes, and binds as decree. The deictic claim moves total knowledge “into a book.” I infer that recording articulates relations among all known events so judgment of differences in 22:69 is not episodic. The book reads as a joined, authoritative knowledge structure.
2. **Ease comes from complete openness, not triviality.** `ي س ر B001/B005` gives ready opening and light movement. Because nothing in either domain lies outside knowledge, I infer that inscription and retrieval meet no hidden resistance. *Yasīr* therefore reads as unobstructed execution of comprehensive knowledge, not minimization of the creation's complexity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:76 supplied a dynamic counterpart to the book: all affairs return, so the joined record is not static storage but the knowledge-ground of returned accountability.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Comprehensive knowledge is made retrievable through inscription.** Fixed repeated `ع ل م:B001` spans sky (`س م و:B004`) and earth (`ء ر ض:B001`), then locates “that” in `ك ت ب:B002` (letters joined into writing and book), with `B003` available as binding inscription. `22:69` supplied future adjudication among divergent paths; `22:71-72` contrast unsupported worship with recited clear signs. The packet supplies total scope, record, and later dispute; I infer that inscription stabilizes distinctions for judgment rather than allowing them to dissolve in time. The book reads as an epistemic structure, not a decorative assertion.
2. **Ease follows ordered containment, not triviality.** Fixed `يَسِير` activates `ي س ر:B001` (ease and ready opening). Its demonstrative points to knowing and recording the whole field. I infer that the task is easy relative to the knower because the information is already encompassed and ordered, not because the field is small.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:71` contrasts worship without knowledge or authority, and `22:72` supplies clear sequential recitation. These make the fixed book function as the stable evidentiary counterpart to unsupported claims.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4 (22:58-78) - Distributed Rites Remain Under One Adjudication
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communities receive distinct ritual forms, but dispute, knowledge, and final judgment remain gathered under a single authority.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual plurality is neither erased nor left unbounded; it is organized like assigned work whose disagreements are transferred to a common court and archive.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir şeyi bilme ve gerçeğiyle kavramadır; bildirme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında yenme ayrı biçimlere bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığı başkalarından ayıracak görünür bir işaretle tanıtmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın çekirdeği işaretleme eylemine daha sıkı bağlıdır; odak dal ise konmuş işaretlerin yanında doğal kılavuzları ve bayrağı da adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal işaret koyma dışında bayrak, dağ, yol kılavuzu ve kumaş deseni gibi bağımsız adları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, hayvana veya nesneye yakma, kesme ya da benzeri yolla bırakılan bedensel ve maddi damgayı gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal görünür bir belirti aracılığıyla tanıtma ve ayırt etme işlevini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Damga bir yüzeye bilerek bırakılan fiziksel izdir; odak dalın işareti ise doğal veya yapılmış olabilir ve yön gösterme işlevi de taşıyabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: En yararlı karşılaştırmalar geçmişten kalan iz, bilerek konan tanıtıcı işaret ve fiziksel damga ile yapıldı; bayrak adayı yalnızca tek bir alt gerçekleşmeyi, öteki adaylar ise daha uzak renk veya biçim belirtilerini karşılar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلامة والعلم والراية والجبل والمعلم ومعالم الطريق والحدود وعلم الثوب ورقمه وتعليم الفارس والثوب والقدح والعمامة والحناء إذا جعلت علامة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو إدراك العلم ولا اسم الخلق ولا شق الشفة العليا
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح واحد يدل على أثر بالشيء يتميز به عن غيره (maqayis)؛ العلامة وهي معروفة (maqayis)؛ العلم الراية والجمع أعلام (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلم الجبل الطويل والجميع الأعلام (ayn)؛ العلم الجبل (sihah;mufradat)؛ المعلم الأثر يستدل به على الطريق (sihah;tahdhib)؛ علم الثوب ورقمه في أطرافه (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ أعلم الفارس إذا كانت له علامة في الحرب (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلام الحناء (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ علمت عمتي أعلمها علما (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı yaratılmışların bütünü, gök düzeni ve içindekiler ya da yaratıkların ayrı sınıfları olarak açıklar. Her sınıfın ve bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması adlandırmanın gerekçesidir; bilme eylemi veya somut işaret dalıyla özdeş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yaratılmış varlıkların bütünü veya sınıflarıyla sınırlıdır; bilme durumu ve bağımsız bir fiziksel işaret anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak dalın evren, yaratılmışların bütünü ve varlık sınıfları anlamlarını verir; başka kuruluşlardan anlam aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yaratılmış olanların bütünü; bağlama göre evren ile içindekilerin tamamı veya yaratıkların ayrı ayrı sınıflarıdır. Bu bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması, adın açıklanan dayanağıdır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaratılmış varlıkların tümünü tek bir düzen veya bütün olarak anlatan temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Evreni ve onun içindeki yaratılmışların bütününü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün bütün evren yerine insan, görünmeyen varlıklar veya başka bir yaratık cinsi gibi ayrı sınıflara dağıtıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her yaratık cinsinin ayrı bir bütün sayılması yönünü korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların çoğu hayvan bedenindeki renk ve işaretleri ya da ilgisiz özel adları anlatır; aynı kökün bilme ve işaret dalları adlandırma gerekçesini açıklasa da bu dalın yaratılmışlar bütünü sınırını keskinleştirecek bir karşıtlık oluşturmaz.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العالم والعالمون بمعنى الخلق أو أصناف الخلائق أو كل جنس من الخلق لأنه معلم في نفسه ودال
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو العلم بمعنى المعرفة ولا العلم بمعنى الراية أو الجبل
branches.source_phrase_ar: العالمون كل جنس من الخلق فهو في نفسه معلم وعلم (maqayis)؛ العالم الخلق والجمع العوالم (sihah)؛ العالمين رب الجن والإنس ورب الخلق كلهم (tahdhib)؛ العالم اسم للفلك وما يحويه وهو في الأصل اسم لما يعلم به (mufradat)؛ أصناف الخلائق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça üst dudaktaki yarıkla sınırlar; insanın üst dudağının yarılmış olması, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki aynı belirti ve üst dudağı yarma eylemi bu kimliği doğrular. Genel yarılma anlamı veya alt dudaktaki bir biçim bozukluğu bu dala dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirti özellikle üst dudakta bulunur; genel çatlaklar, alt dudak ve ağız çevresindeki başka eğrilikler kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Üst dudak yarığı dalın temelidir; yarıklı kişi veya deve nitelemesi ile üst dudağı yarma eylemi ilgili biçimlere bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın üst dudağında veya devenin üst dudak bölgesinde bulunan belirgin yarıktır. Aynı dal, bu özelliği taşıyanı niteleyen biçimi ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Üst dudakta bulunan yarık, dalın anatomik çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Üst dudağı yarık insan veya üst dudak bölgesinde bu belirti bulunan deve, özelliği taşıyan varlık olarak nitelenir.
Birinin üst dudağını yarmak, anatomik sonucun oluşturulmasını bildiren eylemsel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yarığın yerini üst dudak olarak ortak biçimde sınırlar ve yarıklı insanı bu özellikle niteler. Toplu tanıklık, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki karşılığını ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de aynı dalda gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki belirgin yarığı adlandıran temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yarığın türünü ve özellikle üst dudaktaki yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanı veya deveyi üst dudak bölgesindeki yarıkla niteleyen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Özelliğin taşıyıcıda bulunmasını ve anatomik yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin üst dudağında yarık oluşturma eylemini anlatan kuruluşta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemi, etkilenen kişiyi ve üst dudak sınırını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üst dudağı yarık kişi veya deve

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal belirli bir anatomik yerde, üst dudakta bulunan yarığı ve bu yarıkla niteleneni bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nesne, deri, toprak, dağ ve başka yüzeylerdeki genel yarılma ve açılma sürecini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: üst dudak yarığı ile genel yarılma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda bir yüzeyin ayrılmasıyla oluşan yarık düşüncesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yer ve sonuç bakımından üst dudağa özelleşmiş anatomik bir addır; komşu dal ise nesne ve yüzey türü bakımından geniş bir yarılma eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda üst dudak dokusunun yarılmış olması gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda ağız, dudak veya gözün bir yana eğri oluşu vardır; doku yarığı gerekmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yüz ve ağız çevresindeki belirgin bir yapısal özelliği adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yarık, dokuda açılma veya ayrılmadır; eğrilik ise bir bölümün yana yönelmiş biçimidir ve üst dudakta bir açıklık gerektirmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Genel yarılma dalı süreç ve kapsam farkını, ağız eğriliği dalı ise yakın anatomik karışmayı açıklar; öteki adaylar kırık iyileşmesi, hayvan yapısı veya daha uzak ayrılma türleridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلم والشق في الشفة العليا ووصف الرجل أو البعير بالأعلم إذا كان الشق أو العلم في الموضع الأعلى
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو العلم بمعنى المعرفة ولا العلامة الموضوعة اختيارا ولا الشق في الشفة السفلى
branches.source_phrase_ar: العلم الشق في الشفة العليا والرجل أعلم (maqayis)؛ الأعلم الذي انشقت شفته العليا (ayn)؛ علم الرجل يعلم علما إذا صار أعلم وهو المشقوق الشفة العليا (sihah)؛ علمت الرجل أعلمه علما إذا شققت شفته العليا (tahdhib)؛ البعير يقال له أعلم لعلم في مشفره الأعلى (tahdhib)؛ الشق في الشفة العليا علم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deniz ile suyu bol kuyu tek bir ara nesnede birleştirilmez; bunlar aynı biçimin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı sözlük karşılığıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak sözlük biçiminin deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını ayrı ayrı korur; bunlardan genel bir su birikintisi anlamı türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözlük biçiminin bir kullanımda denizi, başka bir kullanımda ise suyu bol kuyuyu adlandırmasıdır. İki karşılık, genel bir su birikintisi anlamında kaynaştırılmaz.

facets.statement: Dal, aynı adın iki ayrı su varlığına verilen sözlük karşılıklarını birlikte kaydeder.
Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık iki karşılığı yan yana verir: bir aktarım sözcüğü deniz olarak açıklar, öteki tanıklıklar ise suyu bol kuyu anlamını destekler. Kaynaklara özgü ayrı claim kimlikleri bulunmadığı için bu karşıtlık ortak özet içinde, atıf uydurulmadan korunur.

concept_gloss.text: deniz ya da suyu bol kuyu
concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlük biçiminin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı karşılığını eksiltmeden birlikte göstermek gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını birbirine indirgemeden korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözlük biçiminin geniş su kütlesi karşılığıyla kullanıldığı tanıklığa özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Deniz karşılığını doğal ve doğrudan biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Aynı biçim için tanıklanan suyu bol kuyu karşılığını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözlük biçiminin bol su içeren kuyu karşılığıyla kullanıldığı tanıklıklara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyu türünü ve suyunun çokluğu koşulunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Aynı biçim için tanıklanan deniz karşılığını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal aynı sözlük biçiminin suyu bol kuyu karşılığını da bağımsız bir seçenek olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal deniz yanında büyük ırmak ve farklı büyüklükte su alanlarına uzanan genel bir geniş su kapsamına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Odak dalın deniz karşılığı, komşu dalın geniş ve çok su çekirdeğiyle örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnızca deniz karşılığındadır; odak dalın kuyu seçeneği komşuda bulunmaz, komşunun büyük ırmak ve genel su genişliği ise odak dalın tanımına girmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuyunun kendisini suyunun bol olması koşuluyla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuyudaki kovadan dökülen veya havuza taşan suyu, kokusunu ve taşma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: suyu bol kuyu ile kuyu suyu
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kuyu çevresinde suyun çokluğu ve görünür birikimiyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal suyu taşıyan kuyuyu niteler; komşu dal ise kuyudan dökülen suyu ve taşma sürecini merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Deniz karşılığını açıklayan geniş su dalı ile kuyu çevresindeki bol su dalı seçildi; diğer adaylar gölet, artık su, taşkın veya su tutan arazi gibi farklı taşıyıcı ve süreçlere bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden yırtıcı kuş için verir ve geçici dal görüntüsünü doğrular. Çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi ise kuş adından türetilmiş ayrı bir biçimdir; kuşun tanımına doğrudan katılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yırtıcı kuş adıdır; çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi yalnızca bu addan türeyen biçime bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş adını tanımlar; insan nitelemesi türemiş bir sözcüksel uzantı olarak bağımlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Doğan veya atmaca türünden bir yırtıcı kuş adıdır. Bu kuş adından türetilen bir niteleme, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği anlatır.

facets.statement: Ad, doğan veya atmaca türünden avcı bir kuşu gösterir.
Kuş adından türeyen insan nitelemesi, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal tek bir sözlük tanıklığında yırtıcı kuş adı ile bu addan türetilmiş çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesini birlikte sunar.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş için verir ve türemiş biçimi çevik, zeki erkek olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: doğan veya atmaca türü yırtıcı kuş
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın temel kuş adını iki kaynak karşılığı arasındaki seçenekliliği koruyarak açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yırtıcı kuş sınıfını ve doğan ile atmaca karşılıklarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş adından türemiş insan nitelemesinin kullanıldığı bağlama özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan oluşu ile çeviklik ve zekâ niteliklerini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğan veya atmaca karşılığı taşıyan kuş adını ve ondan türeyen insan nitelemesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal mavi renkli, doğan ile atmaca arasında tanımlanan veya beyaz doğan sayılan daha özel bir kuş adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğan ve atmaca çevresindeki avcı kuş adlandırmaları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aynı kuş alanını paylaşsalar da komşu dal renk ve ara tür özellikleriyle daha dar bir kuşu adlandırır; odak dalın türemiş insan nitelemesi de komşuda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğan veya atmaca türünü genel bir adla karşılar ve bu addan insan nitelemesi türetir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle zeki ve keskin bakışlı doğanlara verilen bir adı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: doğan adı ile zeki doğan nitelemesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal doğan türünden yırtıcı kuşları adlandırır ve zekâ çağrışımını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda zekâ kuştan türetilen insan niteliğinde belirginleşir; komşuda ise doğrudan belirli doğanların özelliğidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin iki tanıklığı da sözcüğü doğrudan erkek sırtlan olarak açıklar. Geçici dal görüntüsü bu yalın hayvan adıyla tam uyumludur ve başka bir tür, özellik veya mecaz eklemeyi gerektirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca erkek sırtlanı adlandırır; başka erkek hayvan adları ve benzer sesli su veya kuş adları kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak hayvan adını erkek sırtlanla sınırlar ve başka türlere ya da bağlı kuruluşlara genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Erkek sırtlanı adlandıran yalın bir hayvan adıdır.

facets.statement: Adlandırılan canlı, cinsiyeti erkek olan sırtlandır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğün erkek sırtlanı adlandırdığı konusunda birleşir ve ek bir anlam ayrımı bildirmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvanın türünü ve erkek oluşunu birlikte veren bütün bağlamlarda tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sırtlan türünü ve erkek cinsiyetini eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da hiçbir ek koşul getirmeden erkek sırtlanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlam çekirdeği, hayvan türü ve cinsiyet sınırı aynıdır; ayrım yalnızca kullanılan sözlük biçimindedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad çekirdeği; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.
